title: InferencePoolMember manifest (SPEC-032/SPEC-038/SPEC-053)
description: Hand-authored from airdress-operator crates/airdress-operator/src/inference/types.rs (PoolMemberSpec). The operator publishes no schema (design §5.3); this file is the extension's honest, version-pinned copy.

backend.description: Backend identifier: "vllm-openai" (OpenAI-API upstream) or "echo" (SPEC-053, no upstream). The reconciler's validate() rejects unknown values at apply time.

url.description: Upstream URL the operator probes and forwards inference to. Required for vllm-openai over http-direct; omitted for echo and operator-signal members.

authSecretRef.description: Secret-vault key holding the upstream bearer token. The manifest carries only the reference name — never the secret.

caFileRef.description: Optional secret-vault key for a private-CA bundle (Tailscale-style CAs, LE staging).

models.description: Models this member advertises; probed against the upstream's GET /v1/models each tick.

draining.description: When true, the router stops sending new traffic; in-flight requests complete.

transport.description: SPEC-038 transport discriminator. Omitted means http-direct.

computeOperatorRef.description: Enrolled compute-role operator to dispatch through. REQUIRED when transport is operator-signal; REJECTED with http-direct.

supportsMultiConversation.description: Whether this backend can serve multiple concurrent, independent conversations.
